title: 2.4 Was ist das?
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with un/una and el/la, count them, and say their color and size with the right ending.
goal: Ask what something is with ¿Qué es esto? and answer with Es un/una.
grammar_function: ¿Qué es esto? Es un/una + noun; quién is for people.
speaking_outcome: Ask what something is and answer.

cards.pedagogy_note: question shown above image; introduces fixed question

cards.spanish_translation: What is it? It is a phone.
What is it? It is a bus.
What is it? It is a car.
What is it? It is a park.
What is it? It is a book.
cards.pedagogy_note: complete identifying audio avoids ambiguous bare question
